title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass; Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell; Resampled from 96 to 44.1 khz in r8brain Pro > dithered in Izotope Ozone 3 (MBIT+, high noise shaping, 16 bit depth, normal dither, DC offset filter on) > exported to 16 bit in Audacity 2.0.0 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the legendary Harpur College ‘70 show, highlighted by an epic The Other One and blistering Cosmic Charlie.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this recording’s clear, well‑balanced sound and praise a performance that swings from a tender acoustic set into a ferocious electric marathon. Standout moments include a monster The Other One, a scorching Cosmic Charlie, and tight renditions of Candyman, Cumberland Blues and Deep River Blues. The only drawback noted is that the upload is incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance and sound quality across many reviews; minor issue of incompleteness does not outweigh the strengths.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as great‑sounding, clear and well balanced. No specific mix problems are mentioned; the only criticism is that the release is incomplete.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An acoustic set that builds emotional depth followed by a high‑energy electric set, with a marathon jam where Saint Stephen flows straight into Cosmic Charlie, showcasing the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s lead passages are highlighted, especially at the start of The Other One.
